```diff
+ /// Take a screenshot and save it to the specified path
+ async fn take_screenshot_cli(output_path: &str) -> Result<(), JunoError> {
+     info!("Taking screenshot via CLI: {}", output_path);
+ 
+     let desktop = Desktop::new().map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to initialize desktop interface: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     let screenshot_path = desktop.take_screenshot().await.map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to take screenshot: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     // Move the screenshot to the desired location
+     std::fs::copy(&screenshot_path, output_path).map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to copy screenshot to {}: {}", output_path, e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     // Clean up the temporary file
+     if std::fs::remove_file(&screenshot_path).is_err() {
+         warn!("Failed to remove temporary screenshot file: {}", screenshot_path);
+     }
+ 
+     info!("Screenshot saved to: {}", output_path);
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ /// Perform text-to-speech via CLI
+ async fn perform_tts_cli(text: &str, app: &AppHandle) -> Result<(), JunoError> {
+     info!("Performing TTS via CLI: {}", text);
+ 
+     // Get TTS settings from SettingsManager
+     let settings_manager = SettingsManager::new(app.clone());
+     let settings = settings_manager.get_settings().await;
+ 
+     let voice_id = settings.audio.tts_voice_id.unwrap_or_else(|| "default".to_string());
+     let voice_speed = settings.audio.tts_speed;
+ 
+     // Perform TTS
+     tts::speak_text(text.to_string(), Some(voice_id), Some(voice_speed))
+         .await
+         .map_err(|e| {
+             JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to perform TTS: {}", e))
+         })?;
+ 
+     info!("TTS completed successfully");
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ /// List all available applications via CLI
+ async fn list_applications_cli() -> Result<(), JunoError> {
+     info!("Listing applications via CLI");
+ 
+     let desktop = Desktop::new().map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to initialize desktop interface: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     let apps = desktop.get_app_list().await.map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to get application list: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     println!("Available applications:");
+     for (index, app) in apps.iter().enumerate() {
+         println!("  {}: {}", index + 1, app);
+     }
+ 
+     info!("Listed {} applications", apps.len());
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ /// Process screenshot data from base64 input via CLI
+ async fn process_screenshot_data_cli(screenshot_data: &str) -> Result<(), JunoError> {
+     info!("Processing screenshot data via CLI");
+ 
+     // Decode base64 data
+     let image_data = BASE64_STANDARD.decode(screenshot_data).map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to decode base64 screenshot data: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     // Create temporary file
+     let temp_file = TempFileBuilder::new()
+         .prefix("cli_screenshot_")
+         .suffix(".png")
+         .tempfile()
+         .map_err(|e| {
+             JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to create temporary file: {}", e))
+         })?;
+ 
+     // Write image data to file
+     std::fs::write(temp_file.path(), &image_data).map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to write screenshot data: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     println!("Screenshot saved to: {}", temp_file.path().display());
+     info!("Screenshot data processed successfully");
+ 
+     // Keep the temp file alive
+     temp_file.keep().map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to persist temporary file: {}", e.1))
+     })?;
+ 
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ /// Show current settings via CLI
+ async fn show_settings_cli(app: &AppHandle) -> Result<(), JunoError> {
+     info!("Showing settings via CLI");
+ 
+     let settings_manager = SettingsManager::new(app.clone());
+     let settings = settings_manager.get_settings().await;
+ 
+     // Format settings as pretty JSON
+     let settings_json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&settings).map_err(|e| {
+         JunoError::CliError(format!("Failed to serialize settings: {}", e))
+     })?;
+ 
+     println!("Current Application Settings:");
+     println!("{}", settings_json);
+ 
+     info!("Settings displayed successfully");
+     Ok(())
+ }
  
  /// Handles CLI commands that don't require desktop access when permissions are missing.
```
